scope: File-specific static AST, syntax and CLI --help only
checks: required selected extras flow to existing list
cli_help:
usage: current-sass-tool-reference-v2-builder-v2.py [-h] [--root-21 ROOT_21]
                                                    [--root-main ROOT_MAIN]
                                                    [--extra-input EXTRA_INPUT]
                                                    [--extra-input-21 EXTRA_INPUT_21]
                                                    [--extra-input-main EXTRA_INPUT_MAIN]
                                                    [--write]

Build one finite V2 tool image; authenticate Git data, never execute old
tools. Without --write print the proposed packet digest/counts only. --write
writes only V2 data and the exact INPUTS_SHA literals of the two maintained
tool factories. V1 is a fixed input and is never overwritten. Additional new
source packets or helpers must be named explicitly with --extra-input (both
lines), --extra-input-21 (21.x only), or --extra-input-main (main only). A
named input is required on every selected line; missing files are never
excluded.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root-21 ROOT_21
  --root-main ROOT_MAIN
  --extra-input EXTRA_INPUT
                        Required on both lines; repeatable
  --extra-input-21 EXTRA_INPUT_21
                        Required only on 21.x; repeatable
  --extra-input-main EXTRA_INPUT_MAIN
                        Required only on main; repeatable
  --write
semantics: Shared entries selected on both lines; named21/main entries selected only for that line and always required. No existence fallback or silent omission.
